evidence.irr: **irr 50（2026-08-20・irr=70 の二重読み。v9.9.144 の5点検問）**　『We strive to differentiate our products and secure long-term demand through our engagement with our customers to design in our materials and components as part of their product development processes.』（Item 1A. Risk Factors — Our business is dependent upon our development of innovative products and our customers’ incorporation of those products）——台帳が70の根拠に置いた唯一の文。strive to＝願望形で、規約の(3)に該当し70の根拠にならない　『The value of any design-in largely depends upon the decision of our customers to manufacture their products or systems in sufficient production quantities, the commercial success of the end product and the extent to which the design of our customers’ products or systems could accommodate substitution of competitor products.』（Item 1A. Risk Factors — 同上（上の文の直後））——引用の後半が逆を言う型。会社自身が競合品への置換可能性をdesign-inの価値の条件として挙げる　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『We also face competition from manufacturers of commodity materials, including smaller regional producers, particularly in Asia, that generally compete on price, especially for products later in their life cycle.』 ／ 『While we believe we could obtain and qualify alternative sources for most sole and limited source supplier materials, if necessary, the transition time could be long, particularly if the change requires us to redesign our systems.』　《検問と反証の経緯》検問1: 引用3件とも原本と一字一句一致。検問2: 摩擦の機構を名指しできない。唯一の設計組込文が『We strive to differentiate our products and secure long-term demand through our engagement with our customers to design in our materials』＝願望形で、検問3(3)が名指しする型そのもの（strive to）。検問3: 向き。(3)願望形に該当。さらにqualifの全18件を実読したが顧客が当社製品を認定する文はゼロで、内訳は forward-looking の expressly qualified／当社が自社の代替仕入先を認定する話（we could obtain and qualify alternative sources＝(2)向きが逆）／qualified personnel（HR）／ヘッジ会計のqualify／qualified・non-qualified 年金／Directors: Qualifications／Valuation and Qualifying Accounts。検問4: 反証が同じ段落に同居する。設計組込文の次の文が『the extent to which the design of our customers’ products or systems could accommodate substitution of competitor products』＝会社自身がdesign-inの価値を左右する条件として代替可能性を明記。Competition節も『principally on the basis of innovation, historical customer relationships, product quality, reliability, performance and price』＋『manufacturers of commodity materials … generally compete on price, especially for products later in their life cycle』。リスクに price erosion も明記。顧客約2,800社・10%超の顧客なし。検問5: 70を支える機構が無いので射程を問う段階に至らない。★反証の試み: 70を支える文を機構ごとに全走査した——switch 0件 / switching cost 0件 / re-qualif 0件 / requalif 0件 / installed base 0件 / long-term agreement 0件 / long-term contract 0件 / sole source 0件 / supply agreement 0件 / backlog 0件 / retention rate 0件 / new entrant 0件 / designed into 0件。multi-year 6件は全部ERP導入とDCF評価で顧客契約はゼロ。『消耗品の専用性』候補6件は全部が自社IPの保護（proprietary technology／特許・商標）＝repの領分。唯一それらしい『We manufacture some products to customer specifications which are customized to such a degree that it is unlikely that another entity would purchase these products』はASC606の別途利用不能要件で、転売できないのは当社＝摩擦の向きが逆。以上、70を積極的に支える引用が一件も見つからず、規約どおり50とした。
